# pangolin_site (Data Source)

Looks up a single Pangolin site by its nice ID (the human-readable identifier shown in the Pangolin UI). Returns the full site payload - traffic counters, WireGuard public keys, last ping, status, etc. - that the list endpoint does not expose.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a Pangolin site by its human-readable nice ID (the slug shown
# in the Pangolin UI). Returns the full live payload - WireGuard
# tunnel info, traffic counters, status - that the list endpoint
# does not expose.
data "pangolin_site" "main" {
  nice_id = "smart-marbled-salamander"
}

output "is_online" {
  value = data.pangolin_site.main.online
}

output "tunnel_endpoint" {
  value = data.pangolin_site.main.endpoint
}

# Drive an alert when traffic exceeds a threshold.
output "high_traffic" {
  value = data.pangolin_site.main.megabytes_in > 1000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nice_id` (String) Nice ID of the site to look up (e.g. `smart-marbled-salamander`).

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) WireGuard address (e.g. `100.90.128.0/24`).
- `docker_socket_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Docker socket access is enabled on the site.
- `endpoint` (String) Current public WireGuard endpoint (`ip:port`) of the connector.
- `exit_node_id` (Number) ID of the exit node this site is bound to (null when none).
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site.
- `last_bandwidth_update` (String) ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp of the last bandwidth counter update.
- `last_hole_punch` (Number) Unix epoch seconds of the last successful NAT hole punch.
- `last_ping` (Number) Unix epoch seconds of the last successful keep-alive from the connector.
- `listen_port` (Number) Listen port currently used by the connector behind NAT.
- `megabytes_in` (Number) Total bytes received by the site, expressed in MB.
- `megabytes_out` (Number) Total bytes sent by the site, expressed in MB.
- `name` (String) Display name of the site.
- `newt_id` (String) Newt connector identifier assigned to the site.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the site is currently online.
- `pub_key` (String) WireGuard public key of the site connector (newt).
- `public_key` (String) WireGuard public key of the central exit / hub side of the tunnel.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the site (e.g. `approved`).
- `subnet` (String) WireGuard subnet allocated to the site.
- `type` (String) Site type (e.g. `newt`).
